digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI/MCP tooling
propositions: Authors lack concise, accessible guidance on how to write plans that pass the plan-review gate, currently forced to navigate either gate mechanics or generated reviewer-facing criterion registry
AGENTS.md incorrectly directs authors to the criterion registry for the plan description template, creating misleading pointers
The CLI rebar explain command and MCP explain_criterion tool do not support author-guide lookups (plan, review) alongside criterion-id lookups, limiting discoverability
New hand-written on-ramp docs must be discoverable via rebar explain and MCP while keeping the generated registry as the single source of truth for reviewers
Unknown guide or criterion names must be handled consistently with structured error responses (unknown-id, missing-file) across library, CLI, and MCP surfaces
